title: Ticwatch E
symptom: A Ticwatch E with Wear 2.0 paired with Dexcom G5 but does not work as a standalone collector; data values are not received when used as a standalone collector.
cause: The thread suggests the issue is due to a known bug with Wear 2.0 watches out of the box, and later comments indicate that the Ticwatch E cannot work as a collector without a dedicated patch, regardless of Android version.
fix: One user reported that updating the Ticwatch E to Android 8.0 made it work as a collector, but another user tried both official and unofficial Android 8.0 updates and could not get the collector service running. The thread does not provide a definitive fix; it suggests asking an xDrip developer for a dedicated patch or using a different watch.
evidence_quote: i had the same issue but found a solution. i have updated the ticwatch to android 8.0 and now it works as a collector.
